display_name: E20续训20轮：浅中层梯度预算Fishr与U主路径MixStyle
description: 原生纯CE旧门控cos E20 +20，八方案三种子，逐行自动clean测试
authorization: 用户授权继续84%研究；E20续训追加20轮；浅中层Fishr/MixStyle；三种子、每GPU最多3总进程、自动clean测试

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque ID only; balanced private stream; donor groups from detached q>=.95, never TX truth

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.support_query_ref: No support adaptation; target query capsule only after source freeze
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: L6300 supervision/head warmup; U56700 hidden TX live-student SSL and pseudo-class style donors; V27000 health only. Raw cached IQ only; all old features discarded.

permissions.claim_scope: Fixed-budget source-domain DG exploration on exposed clean benchmark; no target feedback

checkpoint.initialization: corresponding original native CE E20; heads newly initialized; main optimizer reset
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final incremental20, cumulative40; all24 rows tested
checkpoint.inheritance: original scratch L-only E20 -> this20; no E200, previous variant or auxiliary weights
checkpoint.prediction_reuse: same-seed original E20 P0 fixed predictions in independent scorer only
checkpoint.benchmark_context: user-selected exposed E20 development benchmark; not blind confirmation

execution.stop_rule: technical failure stops pending; healthy finish; no automatic retry/overwrite

metric_names: per-layer and combined actual Fishr/CE gradient ratios
style donor eligibility and actual movement

risk_recipe.auxiliary_batch_scope: at most32 fresh source-L packets; R may separately re-encode at most32 cached audit IQ packets; count both
risk_recipe.source_selection: fixed final epoch; all three rows tested
risk_recipe.reference: periodically frozen own student; no EMA teacher
risk_recipe.action_scope: bounded post-receive linear/phase increments; no satellite simulator in training
risk_recipe.source_u_scope: No U access in any arm

source_stress.ranking: clean feasibility then stress mean+worst RX risk; descriptive source-only ranking across three seeds; within .2pp prefer fewer auxiliary parameters
source_stress.selection: three-seed source V only; clean feasibility .5pp then mean+worstRX performance; exact ties lower ratio

feature_recipe.calibration_scope: mature source-L relation buckets; fixed once, no later weight adaptation
feature_recipe.style_scope: native labeled clean CE only; no extra CE or KL
feature_recipe.statistical_ema: gradient statistics only, not an EMA teacher

source_selection.rule: fixed final epoch; every predeclared row tested; no source V epoch selection
source_selection.future_compression: USER EXPLICIT EXCEPTION: clean three-seed mean no more than 0.003 below fixed original E200 permits shorter epoch exploration
source_selection.benchmark_role: exposed development benchmark for epoch budget only; not independent blind test

reference_E200.role: comparison only; never loaded for initialization

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: reset AdamW; epoch cosine20; same LR for all identity parameters; parent20 + incremental20 = total40

semi.target_provider: live detached eval-mode student; no copy or EMA

multilevel.sampling: L only same-day 6TX x 5RX x2; U groups are detached weak predictions, both>=.95, cross RX same day
multilevel.fishr_scope: actual readout weight+bias sample gradients; head values stopped in Fishr; backbone-only regularization
multilevel.gradient_budget_scope: time_fuse for shallow, t2 for middle; per-term before mean; aggregate achieved norms logged

rx_action.L_fit: other five TX AND other two days
rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read
rx_action.critic_fit: actual deterministic CE increment on up to32L, identity detached; smoothL1; zero-action anchored
rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

config.sampling: same seed-private RX/day-balanced full permutation for L and independently U; no TX grouping/hidden U labels
config.feature_target: none; multilevel source gradient variance and optional U main-path style

notes: Design fixed from source execution findings, no target-based hyperparameter selection.
Eight arms CE/SSL/MULTI/MIX_L/MIX_U/FISHR_RAW/FISHR_BUDGET/JOINT; primary JOINT vs MULTI.
20x222=4440 main updates, L128;444step L warmup,888step ramp;3996 U batches, full56700 coverage.
Multilevel only:6300L cached E20 maps then200x60 head-only updates;999x60 extraL aux batches; additional cost measured separately.
Fishr readout weight/bias values detached inside regularizer; actual sample parameter gradient variance across5RX.
Budget coefficient min(10000,.1*ramp*mainCE_norm/(Fishr_norm+1e-12)), detached, then mean2levels; measured combined norms distinguish cross-layer feedback.
MixStyle p.5 Beta(.1,.1) strength.3; both U donor/recipient confidence>=.95, same pseudo-class/day, crossRX, distinctPID.
No satellite, EMA, IQ receiver actions, final-feature/margin loss, averaging or previous auxiliary state.
Source V health only; final incremental20 frozen; all24 rows clean168000 truth-last, results never change training.
Eight GPUs max3 total processes each, including existing owners; technical failures preserve artifacts and stop pending only.

independent_review.scope: native E20 inheritance; L-only head warmup; U label-free style; detached-head Fishr budget/gradients; source counts; clean truth-last/capacity
